title: Reception window at Innovation Academy entrance
objects_and_counts: At least two people are visible by the tops/back of their heads behind the reception counter; both are partially cropped/obscured by the counter and partition.

At least three computer monitors are visible: one monitor at the reception counter (partly obscured by a clear partition) and at least two monitors on workstations behind the reception area (partly obscured).
One reception counter with a raised white service shelf is visible within a large red framed opening.
One small potted plant sits on the right end of the raised white shelf on the reception counter.
One clear acrylic partition is mounted on the reception counter between the visitor side and staff side.
One hand-sanitizer bottle is on the front ledge of the counter near a small cup holding pens.
One small bell and one black pen-cup are on the counter surface close to the sanitizer.
One white plastic basket containing green folders or envelopes is on the left side of the counter; a small label on the basket appears to read 'USED' (see uncertainties).
One stack of papers and a yellow notepad are on the left front of the counter.
One freestanding printer or copier is visible in the back left room on top of a cabinet.
One vertical glass door or panel to the right of the red frame has a large printed sign attached and an electronic display screen is visible through the glass to the right.
One ceiling-mounted dome CCTV camera is visible in the upper right of the image.
Multiple office storage elements (cabinets/drawers) are visible in the back left room; individual drawer counts cannot be precisely determined from this view.
spatial_relations: A large red rectangular frame surrounds a recessed reception window; the red frame fills the central upper portion of the image and opens into the office behind it.
The reception counter runs horizontally across the lower part of the red opening; the raised white service shelf is located on the right portion of that counter.

The potted plant sits on top of the raised white shelf at the right side of the counter; the hand-sanitizer bottle, bell and pen-cup are arranged on the left portion of the counter surface facing the camera.

Behind the counter, office workstations and monitors are arranged back-to-back or in rows extending into the recessed office area; the two partially visible people are at those workstations directly behind the counter.

To the right of the red frame is a glass wall/door with a large printed sign reading 'Innovation Academy' and an electronic display screen visible beyond the glass; the CCTV dome is mounted on the ceiling near this junction.
A printer/copier and storage cabinets are positioned in the back left area of the recessed office, with a doorway visible further left.
colours_and_materials: The prominent frame surrounding the reception opening is painted red with a matte finish.
The reception counter and raised service shelf are white, appearing to be painted or laminated surfaces.
Glass is used in the partition between the reception and the corridor (clear acrylic partition on counter) and for the wall/door to the right (transparent glass with a printed sign attached).
The floor in the foreground appears light blue and smooth (possibly vinyl or painted surface); the office floor inside the red frame is covered with grey carpet tiles.
Office furniture and storage visible inside are mostly neutral shades (white and grey).
The CCTV dome is white or light grey plastic; the potted plant pot appears grey plastic or ceramic.
uncertainties: The exact wording on the electronic display screen to the right is not fully legible; only the fragment 'Speake' is readable.
Text on small papers and posters affixed to the interior partition within the reception opening is unreadable at this resolution and is therefore not transcribed.
The small label on the white basket at the left of the counter appears to read 'USED' but the characters are not perfectly sharp; this reading is tentative.
Exact counts of monitors and workstations are minimum visible counts; additional monitors or computers may be present but obscured from this viewpoint.
The number of people present in the office beyond those two partially visible heads cannot be determined; other people may be seated out of frame or obscured by monitors and partitions.
